data.one_liner: Scans QR codes from the camera or image files on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a platform view for live QR code scanning and a method to decode QR codes from image files. Includes a built‑in UI widget and flashlight control.
use_when: You need quick QR scanning with a ready‑made UI
You target only Android/iOS and can add native permissions
avoid_when: You need web or desktop support
You require heavy customization of the scanning UI
You prefer a pure Dart solution without platform views
strengths: Simple API for both camera and image scanning
Built‑in UI widget and flashlight control
weaknesses: Relies on platform views which may affect performance
Customization of the scanner UI is limited
data.setup_notes: Add camera permission to AndroidManifest, add NSCameraUsageDescription and io.flutter.embedded_views_preview=YES to iOS Info.plist

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pure Dart scanner with web support and more customization

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Google ML Kit based, higher accuracy and cross‑platform

alternatives.name: barcode
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight Dart barcode/QR library without native views
